description: Resolve a job title, a company's internal name for a role, a nickname or a degree name to a canonical VOLO entity. Call this FIRST whenever a person names their job. Returns a match field of exact or approximate — when it is approximate, say which entity you read the question as. Returns null when VOLO does not cover it, which is a gap in this site and not a statement about the job.
name: resolve_occupation_or_major
